evidence: CANDIDATE contained 109 regular files and remained byte-identical under aggregate SHA-256 5a33247391bdcc87270659fc2fb7c315bcd77268aba355789c220acb7a49f126.
The manifest is honest: status GENERATED, labels GENERATED and PARTIAL, independent validation REQUIRED, and productionized false.

Fresh host runs reported reference_tests: PASS (407 checks), public_tests: PASS against the reference, three bounded-runner tests OK, and adversarial_vectors: PASS (12 vectors); the starter's documented 37 failures were reproduced.
Fresh ARM builds exited 0 without diagnostics and exactly reproduced the four recorded reference/starter ELF and BIN hashes and sizes.
The reference ELF is ELF32 little-endian ARM EABI5 at 0x10000, has RX and RW load segments plus a non-executable GNU stack, and has no undefined symbols.
QEMU 9.1.1 emitted all required nominal markers and ABABAB; the submitted repair probe emitted both replacement markers, NO-BUG, and PASS.

An independent two-ready-task ARM probe emitted SELECTED-FIRST, OTHER-SECOND, and INDEPENDENT-ROTATION-PASS, corroborating that a stale yield dispatches the task already selected by policy without overwriting its reused context.

Both learner stages were actually materialized and strictly re-audited at the submitted inventory hashes; independent filesystem inspection found only the six intended post-attempt files and four parent directories added, with no sealed answers.

License text clearly limits CC0 to catalog metadata, records the linked resource as NOASSERTION, grants no generated-material reuse license, and makes no production, fuzz, benchmark, transfer, or review claim.

Revision is required because sealed/reference_tests/run_runtime_qemu.py calls communicate() before checking its 65536-byte ceiling, so a runaway serial producer can consume unbounded memory during the timeout despite the runner's bounded-capture claim.
limitations: PRIOR_BUILD and the cited controller audit were not supplied, so historical preservation claims and the bound prior-content digest could not be independently repeated.

The immutable catalog/upstream snapshot and network access were unavailable; originality and the assertion that linked material was not copied remain provenance claims rather than independently verified facts.
Execution covered QEMU versatilepb/ARM926 only, not physical hardware, interrupts, userspace, multicore behavior, or production workloads.
No fuzz campaign, benchmark study, formal proof, broad security audit, or production assessment was performed or claimed.
Candidate-authored tests and scripts support observations but do not by themselves confer BUILDS, TESTED, TRANSFER_VERIFIED, REVIEWED, or any other promotion label; this verdict is advisory.
